description: The Temple of Zeus at Ancient Nemea stands as a partial Doric colonnade on a stepped podium, with fallen column drums in the grass and the valley beyond. The morning is clear, about 19.0°C. Sources describe nine columns on the site today, three of them ancient; this frame is an interpretation of that ruined corner, not a counted survey.
